member.name: T:Prowl.Graphite.DescriptorTable
member.summary:
A persistent descriptor set written slot by slot and bound whole with , for bindless texture tables and other per frame data. Its layout must have set.
Every binding is partially bound and update after bind: slots never written may stay empty if shaders never read them, and slots may be rewritten while the table is bound. A slot that work still in flight on the GPU reads must not be rewritten until that work has retired. Textures are written in their resting layout, so graph transient textures do not belong in a table.
